info.name: Update a response to a checklist question

params.name: checkListResponseId
params.description:
ID of the response to a checklist question to update.
            Pass the [GET /workorders/{workOrderId}/checklists-responses](/swagger/ui/index?version=3#/WorkOrders/GETv3_workorders__workOrderId__checklists_responses) request to retrieve the response ID.

params.name: overrideAttachments
params.description:
Set to true to remove all existing attachments from the checklist response except for the attachment specified by the `CheckListResponsePictureId` parameter.
            When the CheckListResponsePictureId parameter is not specified and this parameter is set to true, the method removes all existing attachments and adds the file provided in the file parameter to the checklist response.
            When the CheckListResponsePictureId parameter is not specified and this parameter is set to false, the method keeps the existing attachments and adds the new file specified by the file parameter.
            By default, this parameter is set to false.
